run_evaluate_sample_rgb: run the evaluate_sample module with eval_type set to rgb to classify a sample video using an RGB I3D checkpoint
run_evaluate_sample_joint: run the evaluate_sample module with eval_type set to joint to classify a sample video using combined RGB and flow I3D checkpoints
run_evaluate_sample_flow: run the evaluate_sample module with eval_type set to flow to classify a sample video using a flow I3D checkpoint
run_evaluate_sample_rgb600: run the evaluate_sample module with eval_type set to rgb600 to classify a sample video using a 600-class RGB I3D checkpoint
run_evaluate_sample_imagenet: run the evaluate_sample module with imagenet_pretrained flag to restore ImageNet pretrained checkpoints for video classification
